precision: Decimal(50) arithmetic on exact CSV label fields and one-decimal prediction exports; E5 equals the three-component mean rounded with ROUND_HALF_EVEN to 0.1. JSON/CSV results are finite floats; original model precision is not recovered.
scope: Descriptive analysis of the existing E5 candidate on the fixed validation split.

bucket_method.method: Linear quantiles at (n - 1) * q; duplicate edges collapsed; empty intervals omitted.
bucket_method.membership: Lower inclusive, upper exclusive, except the final upper edge is inclusive.
bucket_method.purpose: Data-derived diagnostic bins based on validation true prices. Do not use these results to tune a model and then claim an independent validation estimate.
bucket_method.zero_sse_share: Shares are 0 when total SSE is 0.

threshold_interpretation: Counts with absolute error <= 50 or <= 100 (USD 1,000); diagnostic summaries, not course acceptance criteria.
example_selection: Up to three per category, in order: smallest absolute error, largest positive residual, largest negative residual. No repeated imageid; ties use lexical imageid order. These are extremes, not typical cases.

paired_e3_comparison.interpretation: Descriptive paired comparison on the same split; not a significance test.

limitations: One fixed split and previously selected models; no repeated-seed uncertainty or independent test estimate.
Aggregate improvement does not imply improvement for every price range or image.
Images were not opened by this numerical analysis; image-content explanations require visual inspection.
Training/validation learning curves were not re-evaluated; these residuals alone do not establish overfitting.
